description_en: Lists all origin pools within a site. Supports pagination and searching by origin pool name (exact or fuzzy)
description_zh: 查询站点下所有源地址池，支持分页，可以按源地址名称精确查询、模糊查询
name: ListOriginPools

parameters.help_en: The page number. The default value is 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The value must be an integer from 1 to 500. If you specify a value greater than 500, the system uses 500
parameters.help_zh: 页面大小，大于0的整数，最大500，超过500会置为500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the origin pool
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies how to match the origin pool name. The default is `exact`. Valid values:

`fuzzy`: Performs a fuzzy search.

`exact`: Performs an exact match
parameters.help_zh:
按名称匹配查询类型，支持以下2种类型，默认为精确查询。

fuzzy：模糊查询。
exact：精确查询
parameters.name: match_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies how the results are sorted. By default, results are sorted by ID in descending order. To sort by ID in ascending order, set this parameter to `id`. IDs increase with creation time.

id: Sorts by ID in descending order.

id: Sorts by ID in ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序，支持按ID的升序、降序，默认按ID降序，ID和创建时间正相关。

id: 按ID降序。
id: 按ID升序
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The site ID. To get this ID, call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

Enabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the origin pool is enabled.

`true`: Enabled.

`false`: Disabled
Enabled.description_zh:
源地址池是否启用：

true: 启用；
false：不启用

Id.description_en: The ID of the origin pool

Name.description_en: The name of the origin pool. The name must be unique within a site
Name.description_zh: 源地址池名称，一个站点下源地址池名称唯一

Origins.description_en: The origins in the origin pool
Origins.description_zh: 源地址池里添加的源站信息

items.description_en: An origin in the origin pool
items.description_zh: 源地址池里添加的源站信息

Address.description_en: The address of the origin, such as `www.example.com`

AuthConf.description_en: The authentication configuration. This parameter is required if the origin is an OSS or AWS S3 bucket that requires authentication
AuthConf.description_zh: 鉴权信息，源站为OSS或者S3等源站需要鉴权时，需要传鉴权相关配置信息

AccessKey.description_en: The Access Key ID required for private authentication

AuthType.description_en:
The authentication type. Valid values:

`public`: Public read/write. Use for OSS or AWS S3 origins that have public access permissions.

`private_same_account`: Private, same account. Use for OSS origins that use private authentication within the same account.

`private_cross_account`: Private, cross-account. Use for OSS origins that use private authentication from a different account.

`private`: Private. Use for AWS S3 origins that require private authentication
AuthType.description_zh:
鉴权类型。

public：公共读写，源站为OSS或S3且为公共读写时使用；
private_same_account：私有同账号，源站为OSS，且鉴权类型为同账号私有鉴权时使用；
private_cross_account：私有跨账号，源站为OSS，且鉴权类型为跨账号私有鉴权时使用；
private：源站为S3，且鉴权类型为私有时使用

Region.description_en: The region of the origin. Required for AWS S3 origins
Region.description_zh: 源站为AWS S3时需要传的源站Region

SecretKey.description_en: The Secret Access Key required for private authentication

Version.description_en: The signature version. Required for AWS S3 origins
Version.description_zh: 源站为AWS S3时需要传的签名版本

Enabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the origin is enabled.

`true`: Enabled.

`false`: Disabled
Enabled.description_zh:
源站是否启用：

true: 启用；
false：不启用

Header.description_en: The request header to include in origin fetches. Only the `Host` header is supported
Header.description_zh: 回源时带的请求头，只支持Host

IpVersionPolicy.description_en:
The IP protocol version used for origin fetch requests. Valid values:

`round_robin`: Randomly selects an IPv4 or IPv6 origin.

`ipv4_first`: Prioritizes IPv4 origins.

`ipv6_first`: Prioritizes IPv6 origins.

`follow`: Follows the IP version used by the client
IpVersionPolicy.description_zh:
回源请求使用的 IP 协议版本：
round_robin：默认策略，随机轮询 IPv4 或 IPv6 源站
ipv4_first：优先使用 IPv4 源站
ipv6_first：优先使用 IPv6 源站
follow：优先跟随客户端使用的 IP 版本

Type.description_en:
The type of the origin. Valid values:

`ip_domain`: An origin with an IP address or domain name.

`OSS`: An Alibaba Cloud Object Storage Service (OSS) origin.

`S3`: An AWS S3 origin
Type.description_zh:
源站类型：

ip_domain: ip或域名类型源站；
OSS：OSS地址源站；
S3：AWS S3源站

Weight.description_en: The weight of the origin, an integer from 0 to 100

RecordName.description_en: The domain name assigned to the origin pool. This can be used as the origin address for records within the site
RecordName.description_zh: 为源地址池分配的域名，可以用来作站点下记录的源站地址

ReferenceLBCount.description_en: The number of load balancers that reference this origin pool
ReferenceLBCount.description_zh: 被多少个负载均衡器引用

References.description_en: The resources that reference this origin pool. An origin pool is considered referenced when it is configured as an origin for a load balancer or a record
References.description_zh: 源地址池被引用信息，源地址池被负载均衡器配置或者被记录配置为源站时，被认为是引用

DnsRecords.description_en: A list of Layer 7 records that use this origin pool as an origin
DnsRecords.description_zh: 使用此源地址池为源站的七层记录列表

items.description_en: A Layer 7 record that uses this origin pool as an origin
items.description_zh: 使用此源地址池为源站的七层记录信息

IPARecords.description_en: A list of Layer 4 records that use this origin pool as an origin
IPARecords.description_zh: 使用此源地址池为源站的四层记录列表

items.description_en: A Layer 4 record that uses this origin pool as an origin
items.description_zh: 使用此源地址池为源站的四层记录信息

LoadBalancers.description_en: A list of load balancers that use this origin pool
LoadBalancers.description_zh: 使用此源地址池的负载均衡器列表

items.description_en: A load balancer that uses this origin pool
items.description_zh: 使用此源地址池的负载均衡器信息

Id.description_en: The ID of the load balancer

Name.description_en: The name of the load balancer

SiteId.description_en: The ID of the site to which the origin pool belongs

PageSize.description_en: The number of items returned per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of origin pools found
